title: Cambridge IELTS 14 Test 2 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The chart below shows the value of one country’s exports in various categories during 2015 and 2016. The table shows the percentage change in each category of exports in 2016 compared with 2015.
scenario: Export earnings for five product categories in 2015 and 2016, together with the percentage change in values from 2015 to 2016.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: Export Earnings (2015-2016)
notes: The vertical scale is marked from 10 to 70 in increments of 10.
The table reports percentage changes in export values from 2015 to 2016.
